currentParagraphText: “Spirits of Old, Protect Me,” the Chieftain spoke as the odd energy gathered around his body, forming a full suit of transparent armor.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Spirits of Old, Protect Me,” the Chieftain spoke as the odd energy gathered around his body, forming a full suit of transparent armor.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Spirits of Old, Strengthen Mine Arms,” he continued as his sword began to glow a ghostly light and give off a far more powerful aura. Jake could see the strain on the Chieftain’s body as he spoke one last time.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Upon saying those words, the aura of the Chieftain began to spike as he deployed a boosting skill – another trait more powerful variants tended to have. The same odd greenish-blue aura enveloped his body and began spiking as the ape truly went all out.
